title: Bayes' rule, annotated

steps.annotation: What we're solving for: belief in H after seeing evidence E
Numerator: how well H explains E (likelihood) times how plausible H was to begin with (prior)
Denominator: how surprising E is overall — the normalizing constant that keeps posteriors summing to 1
